content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

- The clause states that the client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment. This would allow the client to end the contract instantly and leave unpaid work. I propose that termination be allowed only for cause upon 30 days’ written notice, and that any work performed up to the termination date be paid according to the Fees schedule.
- The clause states that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to the Client upon delivery. This would transfer ownership before payment is received. I propose that the transfer of intellectual property rights occur only after full payment of the applicable fees for that Deliverable.

Thank you for your consideration.
